items.title: Claude can design electronic prototypes from start to finish
items.summary: We asked Claude to design three electronic devices: a speakerphone, a voice-assistant hub, and a handheld virtual pet. The prototypes worked without any fixes to their circuitry.

items.title: Progress on provable inference for large language models
items.summary: Sharing progress on a powerful type of cryptographic proof known as a zkSNARK, which is uniquely fit for provable inference.

items.title: Teaching AI to build scientific models
items.summary: AI for Science grantees Jakob Macke, Daniel Gedon, and Stefan Wahl on how AI is starting to change how scientific models are built and interpreted.

items.title: The components of agent memory
items.summary: For Claude to learn from experience, it has to decide what’s worth remembering before it knows what’s next. Here’s how “dreaming” helps it organize memory and correct mistakes.

items.title: Project EVE: Claude plays MMORPGs
items.summary: We put Claude in two EVE games to study how AI agents handle markets and teamwork, where they break down, and what safeguards they might need.

items.title: How scientists use Claude
items.summary: We analyzed 207,000 research sessions to learn how Claude is used in science, why some tasks get more use than others, and how AI could speed up discovery.
